regions.today: Hot and humid today, Thursday, with long sunny spells and mostly dry conditions. Highest temperatures of 27 to 30 degrees, with light or moderate east to southeast winds.
regions.tonight: Warm and muggy tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. A few showers will develop overnight, possibly heavy and thundery. Lowest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees with mainly light, variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Continuing warm and humid tomorrow, Friday, with sunny spells and showers. Some of the showers may be heavy and thundery, with a chance of spot flooding, Cloud, mist and coastal fog will develop near the south coast from late morning. Highest temperatures of 24 to 29 degrees, but a few degrees cooler near the south coast. Light variable breezes will become mostly moderate southerly by evening.
regions.solar_uv: High or very high on Thursday, Moderate to high on Friday.
